# The Tender Desk

> The Tender Desk builds websites, makes motion design videos, video ads and reels, writes tenders, runs Google Ads, sets up AI assistants and optimises sites for search and AI answers, for small and local businesses that want more of the right work. Contact: hello@thetenderdesk.co.uk

## Services
Websites are £25 for the first 6 months (site and hosting), then £75 a year. Everything else is quoted individually after a quick chat.
* [Websites](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/websites/): custom, mobile first sites.
* [Motion, ads and reels](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/motion/): motion design videos, video ads and Instagram and TikTok reels, priced per project.
* [Care plans](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/care/): hosting, backups, updates and small changes.
* [SEO and AI search optimisation](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/seo/): schema, FAQ markup, llms.txt, search structure.
* [Google Business Profile setup](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/google-business/)
* [Google Ads](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/google-ads/): campaigns built and managed.
* [Tender writing](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/tenders/): finding contracts, go or no go, method statements, quality answers, social value, PQQ, SQ and frameworks.
* [AI assistant and automation](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/ai/): an assistant that answers and books customers 24/7, plus admin automations.

* [Our work](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/work/): live client sites.
